exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q1: Both operator actions included, four stationary policies reconstructed, strict Bellman choices and discounted bounded terminal argument cover all histories. Residual norm bound is attained.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q2: Two closed classes preserve initial wealth mass. Complete invariant family and one-step projection, capital consistency and absent household incentives correctly separated.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q3: Successor productivity cancellation derived before expectation; excessive saving admits a feasible local variation. Corrected share has bounded log recursion and conditional concavity/nonnegative-capital terminal proof against all adapted histories, not only share rules.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q4: Equal means, unequal savings and type/aggregate budgets verified. Comparing the middle-point atom with the endpoint mixture proves necessity of affine support; affine expectation proves sufficiency.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q5: Worker outside-option feedback held fixed privately and closed in equilibrium. Corrected wage meets worker/firm/Nash/entry conditions. Hosios equality absent; stationary flow comparison cannot replace same-initial discounted welfare.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q6: Forward orientation and both roots reconstructed. Stable eigenvector gives infinitely many deterministic bounded adapted paths without inherited jump conditions; imposing an initial inflation value changes the question.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q7: Finite discounted identity retains the constant terminal claim despite declining ratio. Constant real-debt repair funds all interest through household taxes from date zero; admissibility not inferred from ratio.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q8: Nominal deviation floor correctly equals log beta. Unconstrained branch rejected, binding shadow inequality checked; continuous monotone scalar equation proves only fixed-continuation uniqueness.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q9: Joint safe/risky pricing rejects proposed kernel despite satisfying necessary volatility bound. Full-rank payoff system uniquely repairs kernel; economic preference/mechanism identification does not follow.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q10: Complete positive null-space family and strict open parameter bounds derived. New payoff price identifies states, not a structural theory. Three-equation solve independently reconstructed.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q11: Cash affordability restricts the physical set; strict concavity gives interior global optimizer. Retained cash is separate from the installed-capital average claim; additive fixed rent shifts levels but not derivative or feasible set.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q12: Creditor recovery/equity objective relative to no investment correctly split. Full weak participation interval and strict interior witness supplied; owner liquidity funds the date-zero investment, write-down creates no goods.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q13: Finite-zero utility gives valid expected all-run comparison. Storage, partial liquidation and exhausted-bank branches cover all attempted withdrawal masses, including ties. Piecewise linear shortfall maximum is attained at exhaustion; external reserve both necessary and sufficient. Credible guarantee changes individual incentives without assuming free funding.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q14: Both roots satisfy fixed-price bank retention optimum, cap, debt, equity and buyer spending. Price-taking lower-sale deviation violates the cap. Local update derivative says attraction or repulsion only for specified iteration, no static equilibrium exclusion.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q15: Unequal-probability domestic/foreign kernel units, safe returns, covered replication and covariance excess return reconstructed. Primitive price consistency is not a solved monetary equilibrium.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q16: Private prices remain fixed through household KKT before symmetric clearing. Positive multiplier and unique complementary branch hold; both-date foreign investment/resource accounts close. Stale-price result and aggregate-control misinterpretation distinguished.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q17: Continuous reward maximum directly bounds every action history. True operator residual and loss are sharp; restricted fixed point convergence cannot close omitted action gap.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q18: Mean and indicator variance are redundant. Full interior transition family supplies direct nonidentification proof; lag covariance distinguishes examples. Sampling uncertainty and causal identification remain separate.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q19: Mass-weighted transfer budget balances. Exposure-MPC covariance changes stable local feedback and multiplier. Fixed derivative/distribution and elastic supply closure explicit; output identity is not welfare proof.
exact_prompt_solution_review.v14-exam-b-q20: Nonnegative equivalent mechanism family, augmented inverse and feasible contrast interval verified with endpoints. Exact out-of-domain contrast falsifies stipulated map; proposed research protocol includes dated exposure, comparison, direct confound, reserved target and stopping rule without claiming completed data access.

implementation_review: Author checker is quiet and four-file bounded, explicit guards rather than assertions. source_review.method: All thirteen inherited source identity/URL/scope records read; all ten retained record byte/hash bindings actually verified. Historical source-body/image inspections remain attributed to their recorded chapter inspectors. No new external body retrieval, current PDF availability or visual review claimed.

form_distinction: Substantive diagnosis/reconstruction contrasts with Form A construction: policy-only/coarse operators, reducible classes, excessive savings, passive NK, fiscal tail, underidentified kernels, fixed rents/debt overhang, off-path guarantee, two liquidation equilibria, stale collateral prices and redundant mechanism moments.
administration_review: Exactly twenty five-point prompts and complete five-point additive rubrics; five twenty-point domains with all twelve study routes. Uncalibrated 300-minute design, 85 overall/15 domain plus critical-error remediation/transfer/teach-back. No psychometric equivalence asserted.
validation_scope: Exact-six normal quiet API and isolated optimized API/default CLI actual gate evidence retained separately after final freeze. Numerical witnesses supplement the full universal-proof review documented per prompt.
limits: No author code executed/imported; no empirical replication or independent human certification.
